title: Garrett
creator: CrossFit
description: Three rounds of 75 squats, 25 ring handstand push-ups and 25 L pull-ups. Honours U.S. Marine Capt. Garrett T. "Tubes" Lawton, killed by an IED in Herat Province, Afghanistan, in 2008. Ring handstand push-ups are elite; do them on the wall or as pike push-ups.
